title: Sinan
text: A unified embedding model built on Qwen-3.5-9B for image, video and visual-document retrieval. I worked on data curation, teacher-only hard-negative mining, multi-source training, video sampling and model ensembling.
note: 77.56 average score across 44 MMEB v2 retrieval tasks; exceeded the Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B baseline on 25 tasks. Results from internship experiments.

title: ASC26 · Systems for AI & Science
text: Optimized numerical-relativity workloads with MPI + OpenMP, AVX-512, data-layout changes and kernel fusion. Also contributed to world-model inference optimization with attention caching, mixed precision and dual-GPU execution.
note: 4.33× end-to-end speedup on AMSS-NCKU (RMS error <1%); 3.72–7.58× on world-model inference under the PSNR constraint.
